title: Identity unit law for actual varying-ring inverse-image compositors
statement:
Let $R_n$ be commutative rings with arbitrary maps $\varphi_n:R_{n+1}\to R_n$. For schemes use the actual semilinear module-system operations and specified comparators of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Write $L_f=f^*_{\bullet}$, $c_{f,g}:L_{gf}\simeq L_fL_g$, and $e_X:L_{1_X}\simeq\mathrm{id}$ for the ordinary inverse-image compositor and identity, defined as adjoints of the ordinary sectionwise direct-image comparisons. For every $f:X\to Y$, after transport along $f1_X=f$,
$$ (e_XL_f)\circ c_{1_X,f}=\mathrm{id}_{L_f}.$$
Exactly the same identity holds for $G_f=D(L_f)$, its specified compositor $g_{f,g}$ and $g_X:G_{1_X}\simeq\mathrm{id}$. Thus $(g_XG_f)\circ g_{1_X,f}$ equals the equality-transport comparison $G_{f1_X}\to G_f$, before any coefficient evaluation.

source.place: Tag 07A7 (remark-base-change); unit-preserving adjoint comparisons, with the ordinary base-change section calculation of def-sp-varying-ring-operations; isolated OrdinaryUnits argument

proof.text: Put $P=f_{*,\bullet}$ and $S=(1_X)_{*,\bullet}$, and let $r:S\simeq\mathrm{id}$ be the specified ordinary direct-image identity. Transport the specified direct-image compositor along $f1_X=f$, obtaining $d:PS\simeq P$. By [def-sp-varying-ring-operations], its components and those of $r$ are restrictions along the canonical fibre-product and identity-graph isomorphisms. We claim $d_M=P(r_M)$ for every system $M$. On a level $n$ and a test object $H\to Y$, put $V=H\times_Y X$. Both maps go from $M_n(V\times_X X)$ to $M_n(V)$ and are restriction along the graph $\gamma:V\to V\times_X X$ with projections $1_V$ and the structural map $V\to X$. For $d$ this is the pasting isomorphism with the equality $f1_X=f$ inserted; for $P(r)$ this is the identity graph at the test object $V$. These arrows agree because both projections agree. Restriction functoriality gives equality on every section. Each restriction commutes with the scalar action and with the given semilinear transitions, since these are natural in the test object. Equality of these components is equality of maps of systems, hence $d=P r$ as natural isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 07A7 (remark-base-change), adjoint-comparison convention; explicit section calculation for the identity graph, written here

proof.text:
Write $L=L_f$, $I=L_{1_X}$, and write $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to PL$, $u:\mathrm{id}\to SI$ for the units of the specified adjunctions. Transport $c_{1_X,f}$ on its source to $L$, and call the resulting transformation $c:L\to IL$; put $e=e_X:I\to\mathrm{id}$. The composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction] is $IL\dashv PS$ with unit $P(u_{LA})\circ\eta_A$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] first to $L\dashv P$, $IL\dashv PS$, and $\delta=d:PS\simeq P$. Since the inverse-image compositor of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations] is this unit-preserving adjoint comparison, it gives
$$P(c_A)\circ\eta_A=d_{ILA}\circ P(u_{LA})\circ\eta_A.$$
Apply the same cited theorem to $I\dashv S$, the identity adjunction, and $\delta=r^{-1}:\mathrm{id}\simeq S$. The specified adjoint identity therefore satisfies
$$S(e_B)\circ u_B=r_B^{-1}.$$
All objects $A$ here lie in $\mathscr S_Y$ and all objects $B$ in $\mathscr S_X$; both right-adjoint comparisons are invertible by the specified ordinary operations.

source.place: Tag 0B65 (lemma-transformation-between-functors-and-adjoints), unit form of the adjoint comparison; Tag 0DV0 (lemma-compose-counits), composite adjunction

proof.text:
For $A\in\mathscr S_Y$, naturality of $d:PS\to P$, the two preceding unit equations, and $d=P r$ give
$$\begin{aligned}
P(e_{LA}\circ c_A)\circ\eta_A
&=P(e_{LA})\circ d_{ILA}\circ P(u_{LA})\circ\eta_A\\
&=d_{LA}\circ P(S(e_{LA}))\circ P(u_{LA})\circ\eta_A\\
&=d_{LA}\circ P(r_{LA}^{-1})\circ\eta_A=\eta_A.
\end{aligned}$$
The identity transformation of $L$ has the same unit equation. The uniqueness clause of [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation], with both adjunctions $L\dashv P$ and $\delta=\mathrm{id}_P$, gives $e_L\circ c=\mathrm{id}_L$. Undoing the source transport proves precisely the ordinary assertion, rather than identifying $L_{f1_X}$ and $L_f$ without their equality comparison.

source.place: Tag 0B65 (lemma-transformation-between-functors-and-adjoints), uniqueness of the unit-preserving comparison; explicit naturality calculation

proof.text: The categories $\mathscr S_X,\mathscr S_Y$ are abelian and $L,I$ are additive exact by [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Apply [lem-sp-exact-derived-transformation-pasting] to the resulting equality $e_L\circ c=\mathrm{id}_L$ of Step 3: the edges of this finite diagram are only $L$, $I$, $L_{f1_X}$ and identity functors, all additive exact, and its cells include the specified compositor, identity comparison and equality transport. The nonexact right adjoints $P,S$ and their units were used only to prove the ordinary equality; they are not edges of the diagram being localized. Its compositor unit assertion localizes this actual equality. More explicitly, write $a:D(IL)\simeq D(I)D(L)$ and $b:D(\mathrm{id})\simeq\mathrm{id}$ for the standard exact composition and identity comparisons. By the specified operations, $g_{1_X,f}$ is $D(c_{1_X,f})$ followed by $a$, and $g_X$ is $D(e)$ followed by $b$. The cited pasting theorem identifies their whiskered composite with $D(e_L\circ c)$ followed by the same identity comparison, so Step 3 makes it the identity on $G_f$ after source transport. For clarity, localization sends the transport for an equality $h:f1_X=f$ to the transport of $G$: elimination of $h$ reduces this to localization sending the identity transformation to the identity transformation, which is included in the cited pasting assertion. Thus before transport the composite is exactly $G_{f1_X}\to G_f$ induced by $h$. This is an equality on the ordinary unbounded derived category of systems itself.

split_report.summary: Q36 proves direct-image identity coherence by comparing the two identity-graph restrictions, writes out the adjunction-unit equations and their naturality cancellation, and derives the equation using the existing exact transformation pasting theorem. No statement change and no new nodes. Every cited node statement was read and quotations are supplied. No Lean writing or compilation.

Steps 1–3 establish the ordinary unit law and Step 4 passes it to the specified system derived category.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q36-12163b236 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item and all four cited statements in full, plus the unit and the parent citer. The delivery has zero new nodes and the statement is unchanged; the unit law is true for arbitrary rings and transitions, and I checked it on f=1_X, X empty and non-flat Z/4->Z/2. Step 1 (elementary): d=P(r) because both are restriction along the map V->V x_X X with projections (1_V, structure map), and fibre-product uniqueness makes these equal. This matches modulePComp/modulePId's section formulas (VaryingRingOperations.lean:820-980). Step 2: the composite-adjunction unit P(u_LA)eta_A fits def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction. Two applications of the conjugate unit lemma give P(c)eta = d P(u)eta and S(e)u = r^-1, with the right directions (moduleGComp = leftAdjointCompIso.symm, gId = leftAdjointIdIso). Step 3 (elementary): I re-derived the cancellation, naturality of d plus d=P(r) gives eta, and uniqueness with delta=id gives e_L c = id. Step 4: only exact edges L, I, L_{f1_X} are localized. g and gId are D(c) or D(e) followed by the exact composition or identity comparison, matching Lean gComp/gId. lem-sp-exact-derived-transformation-pasting (same unit, unsplit, no cycle) states that unit equations pass to the derived category. Off-unit uses are Mathlib leaves, so no tool_uses are needed. No duplicates: lem-sfb-eta-id is condensed and lem-sp-varying-ring-open-unit-coherence is the open sibling. No SGA, no repair note, no fixes.
